deskyard computer remove: remove a computer (admin)

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer remove NAME [--delete-files]

Removes a computer: its container, its grants to accounts and its shares
(closing their connections). Its files in home/NAME/ are kept unless
--delete-files; volumes are never touched.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  computer name

Options:
  --delete-files       also delete the computer's files (home/NAME/)
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard computer remove bob
  deskyard computer remove bob --delete-files

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
